page.layout: One block of verse in the centre of the page, with a running head above it; a signature mark "I." at the lower right below the last line. No marginal notes.

p.i: Ni fallor, unus esse volet aquarius,
Has tractat artes ille non incommodè,
Quas est professus se tenere, non tenet:
Nec scit docere: scire nec penitus studet.
Vt ponit hirci latera pro verucibus,

page.notes: The verse is set in italic type. The text is mostly legible; a few words (e.g. "Sed olida comiciorib9", "Vt ponit") are doubtful. The line "Seplasiana" and "Interpolare aßiuior" are read with some uncertainty. Pencilled or printed marks at the lower right ("I.") are read as the signature.
